design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — worker_early_wage_access task 0 (Teodora Pineda, Marigold Bistro Group). Revision 2 (rework of the round-1 policy audit).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 4]}. Assignment: access_ext_tier_review 4 factors, access_ext_bank_transfer_amount 6, access_ext_bank_transfer_fee 4 (root). Task 1 (draw {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "factor_counts": [5, 5]}) holds access_ext_missed_recovery_review and access_ext_instant_transfer_amount; nothing of task 1 is claimed here. Claimed here: the tier review of a payday without a shortfall, the next-business-day bank transfer amount (owner=user) and the bank transfer fee; tools record_tier_review_be8f1edd, request_bank_transfer_bc93e4f0, book_bank_transfer_fee_9f154276.
DSL decision (kept from round 1): the compute runs on the worker's plan, so the employer agreement (configured_cap_percent, fee_model) is read by the agent only: the bank transfer schedule is scoped by a self-naming overwrite to a worker with one plan whose employer's configured percentage is not below the bank transfer percentage (60 >= 54 here); the employer fee model only decides whether the fee is payable (worker_paid here). The cross-difficulty factor reads the worker's own card account and card ledger.

[Round-2 changes for this task] P1: the bank fee is now quoted with the transfer and booked after it ("booked only after", "the figure quoted is the figure booked"; the schedule prices the transfer as confirmed). P2: the review's return to Starter follows the plan's latest write-off when it was booked on or after the level_effective_date and on or before the payday reviewed; a write-off booked after the payday reviewed counts at the next payday's review (declared overwrite of the base write-off timing), so every write-off is taken exactly once. P3: the bank deduction-ceiling room uses the base accrual measure (recorded nets less corrections). P4: every assembly and overwrite sentence is generic ("any adjustment that adds to / multiplies / sets / decides ..."). F2: the binary open-shortfall allowance is gone; the open shortfall is a plain gate (base entry gate) and a six-month earnings allowance takes its place. F3: the bank fee is no longer a flat fee times stacked percentage shares: it is a flat fee chosen by settlement timing (after the 17:00 cutoff the transfer settles a day later), a flat amount-band surcharge, the free first bank transfer of a pay period (withheld from workers with four or more other transfers that period), and the pay-frequency-prorated period cap. The world moved accordingly: frozen 18:40 (after the cutoff), the current period holds three instant pushes and one card transfer, instant fees are priced by the base fee rule (the extended instant-fee schedule is withdrawn), and the August bank transfer was the period's first bank transfer (no fee, so nothing to reverse).

[Why a good test] One plain request — the most earned pay to her bank account by Friday. Getting it right needs: noticing the 2026-10-15 payday has its recovery booked (2026-10-20, late employer file) but no review (level_effective_date 2026-10-01, the day after the 2026-09-30 payday the Plus review covered); running that review (the payday carries no shortfall, so the tier review schedule) with a twelve-month count whose method depends on the window's shortfall reasons and a six-month earnings allowance; reconstructing the bank accrued net from 19 sync lines and a correction with three line-level schedules (own-ratio estimate, tips share, overtime share); the card ledger (another difficulty's product) for card wage points; the August bank return for the return share; the worker confirming the quoted transfer herself; and the fee priced from that transfer with timing, band, free-allowance and cap rules.

[Problem-tree card] root access_ext_bank_transfer_fee. Edge 1 fee -> access_ext_bank_transfer_amount, value_input, gate bf_amount, state form: "The bank transfer fee is booked only after the next-business-day bank transfer it prices stands on the plan's ledger as today's latest transfer entry." (affirmative). Only request_bank_transfer_bc93e4f0 writes a bank-account transfer. Opening: today's latest transfer entry does not exist (latest 2026-10-20, to the Paystride card). Edge 2 bank amount -> access_ext_tier_review, value_input, gate bt_pct, state form: "The bank transfer amount is worked out only after the plan's level effective date falls after the pay date of its latest period close line, where it has one, that pay date is before today and no shortfall carries a pay date on or after the level effective date." The scope clause makes the resolver unique: with no shortfall carrying a payday no review has yet covered only the tier review schedule records the level effective date (the missed-recovery schedule covers plans with such a shortfall). Opening: 2026-10-01 vs 2026-10-15 — false. Order: review -> transfer (worker) -> fee. Deletion runs: skip the review -> 67.50 (Plus: pay-period room 135.00 binds) instead of 144.74; skip the transfer -> the schedule prices no transfer of today (1.49 listed, no surcharge) instead of 1.24. The instant schedule's sentence (task 1) is negated ("not ... until"); this one affirmative.

[Base-invariant card] review: plan_active_for_review (active). Transfer: plan_active; access_cutoff (anchor next_pay_date 2026-10-30, Preferred 1 business day -> 2026-10-29, not_after, exclusive; today 2026-10-21); one plan (day limits per plan, 0 today); no loan; bank destination. Fee: one_fee_per_transfer (the new transfer has no fee entry). Per-transfer minimum 5.00, min accrued 25.00, 3 per day / 8 per period at Preferred: inside. After 17:00 the NBD request is treated as made the next business day: delivered Friday 2026-10-23.

[Business-object card] Plan e958ae77 (one plan). Bank period taken = transfers carrying 2026-10-30: 60.00, 75.00, 90.00 (instant, external debit card, fees 2.99 each) and 140.00 (instant, Paystride card, no fee) = 365.00. Fees of the period 8.97. Other transfers carrying the pay date when the bank transfer is priced: 4. The fee points to the transfer booked tonight.

[Factor card — tier review (4)] recovery_count_method (method): one window shortfall, deduction_not_taken -> count 6 -> Preferred; baseline standard count 0 -> Plus. tenure_allowance (parameter): 248 days -> Premier; baseline Starter -> Plus. writeoff_allowance (parameter): none -> Premier Plus; baseline -> Plus. earnings_allowance (parameter): 4781.38 in six months -> Preferred; baseline -> Plus. Whole baseline (keep the tier) Plus; gold Preferred. Near-miss: the 2026-08-31 shortfall.
[Factor card — bank transfer amount (6)] card_wage_points (cross card, multi-source): 4 payroll loads -> +10 (near-miss the 08-14 load; the 10-20 ewa load is not payroll) -> baseline 90.20. tenure_share 0.9 -> 150.00. tips_share (multi-source) 0.75 -> 150.00. overtime_share 0.5 -> 150.00. estimate_method (method) own ratio 277.89 vs 239.40 -> 134.35. return_share 0.5 -> 289.49. Whole baseline 270.36. Gold 144.74 (0.54 x 1212.025 - 365.00 = 289.4935 x 0.5, rounded down).
[Factor card — bank transfer fee (4)] free_transfer_allowance (parameter): first bank transfer of the period with 4 other transfers -> fee charged; baseline free -> 0.00. settlement_timing_fee (parameter): after 17:00 on a Wednesday -> 1.49 - 0.50 = 0.99; baseline 1.49 -> 1.73 (room binds). bank_band_surcharge (parameter): 144.74 -> 0.25; baseline -> 0.99. cap_period_method (method): semimonthly 9.99 x 15/14 - 8.97 = 1.7336; baseline 9.99 - 8.97 = 1.02 binds -> 1.02. Whole baseline 0.00 (free first transfer). Gold 0.99 + 0.25 = 1.24. No two factors cancel (−0.50 and +0.25).

[XF recipe] Defining sentences: bank fee "bank transfer fee" B1 (incl. the free first transfer), "bank fee room" B2, timing F_SETTLE, band F_BAND, allowance F_FREE, cap F_CAP, weekday/time WEEKDAY, order ORDER (generic). Review: SCOPE (payday without shortfall), ONCE (one review per payday), B1 reset/keep, B2 ranks, OPEN (plain gate), ASSEMBLY (generic), each allowance its own sentence. Bank amount unchanged except B5 (base accrual measure) and generic ORDER / EST_NEW / SOURCES_NEW. Factor-reads (transitive): no factor reads another factor's binding; bf_first/bf_amount/bf_pay/bf_time, bt_accrued/bt_pct/bt_lowest, rv_open/rv_up are plain. Method pairs: cap_period_method weekly (adds prior-period fees) / semimonthly (adds day ratio) / biweekly; estimate_method own ratio / blend / recorded; recovery_count_method closes (no shortfall, or every shortfall a deduction not taken) / closes less shortfalls / zero (fall-through = baseline Starter) — all pairwise distinct. T1/T2: the fee is min(charged + surcharge, room): room 1.7336 > 1.24 so every fee-side factor bites; the cap baseline binds (1.02). Review min(current+1, allowances) inside max(current, ·): each allowance baseline (Starter) holds the plan at Plus. Probes: MAX daily_sequence + LATEST for today's latest transfer (absent -> amount 0, time 00:00, pay date the plan's next payday; unique per plan per day); COUNT bank transfers of the pay date (decoy instant/card transfers excluded by destination); LATEST write-off (absent -> no reset, allowance Premier Plus); LATEST period close (absent -> tenure 0, no review due); CFIELD loan (absent -> no ceiling); EXISTS / CFIELD active card (decoy closed account excluded by status). Events written: access_level_change, access_transfer to bank_account (card trigger never fires), access_fee. compute_basis verbatim (scratch sweep: 0 misses).

[Seed] Customers (worker, employer), live Enterprise agreement (worker_paid, configured 60), live Select paycard program, card account with 16 semimonthly payroll loads and purchases and the 2026-10-20 ewa_transfer load; plan since 2026-07-20 with six closed periods (syncs, corrections, period closes), recoveries equal to each payday's amount due, the 2026-08-31 deduction_not_taken shortfall carried and recovered, the August bank transfer returned, base-priced instant fees, the current period's four transfers. Card payroll loads after enrollment = period close net less that payday's recovery; card balance = the card ledger's net.

[Persona] Teodora calls after her lunch shift (18:40); volunteers the goal (most earned pay to her bank account by Friday, rent) and the hard preference (not the card); identity and every askable fact only when asked; agrees to service work, accepts the quoted amount and cost, confirms the transfer herself, ends when told it is all set. No hint of the review or the fee booking.

[Standard solution] verify -> read plan, earnings, ledger, agreement, card account, paycard program, card ledger, loans -> the 2026-10-15 review is owed (no shortfall carries a payday on or after 2026-10-01) -> record Preferred from 2026-10-16 -> compute 144.74 and its fee 1.24 -> quote both -> the worker confirms the transfer (daily_sequence 1) -> book the fee 1.24 on the returned transfer reference. Round 4 (R3): level_effective_date is always the day after the payday a review covers, whatever day the review is recorded, so a payday's review is due exactly while level_effective_date is on or before that payday; a late review of an earlier payday leaves it on or before the next payday, and reviews of different paydays never block each other. Transfers and fees booked before a review is recorded keep their booked terms (declared overwrite). Scored values unchanged. Round 5 (R4a): a payday's review is recorded no earlier than the day after that payday, so a write-off booked on a payday always stands before that payday's review and each review's write-off window runs from the day after the previous reviewed payday through this payday; every write-off is taken exactly once. On a payday itself the amount sentences do not wait on that payday's review (its pay date is not yet before today). Here the 2026-10-15 review is recorded 2026-10-21. Round 7 (S1): the review states once, generically, that an allowance permits only Starter unless one of its own tiers names a higher tier, and that sentence is part of baseline.rule; every allowance's declared baseline and fall-through is Starter (the recovery-count method has three distinct methods: the paydays when no shortfall or only deductions not taken stand, the paydays less carried shortfalls, else a zero count), so the move-up clause is never met by default.
user_scenario:
You are Teodora Pineda, a 35-year-old server at one of the Marigold Bistro Group restaurants in Columbus, Ohio. You are calling the Paystride support line from your phone after your lunch shift ended, a little tired and a little embarrassed about money, but polite and clear. Your rent is due Friday and your landlord only takes payment from your bank account, so what you want tonight is simple: take out as much of the pay you have already earned as Paystride will let you, and send it to your own bank account so it lands there by Friday. You open the call by saying roughly that: you want the most you can get of your earned pay sent to your bank account, arriving by Friday, because of rent. You do not want it on your Paystride card this time, because the landlord pulls rent from your checking account; if the agent offers the card instead, you politely say the bank account is the one you need. You do not know how Paystride works out the amount, you have no figure in mind, and you will take whatever the maximum turns out to be.

When the agent asks who you are, you give your full name, Teodora Pineda, and your mobile number, 7135550142. If the agent needs one more detail you give the last four of your Social Security number, 4417; only if they still ask do you give your date of birth, 1991-06-23, your home ZIP code, 43206, or your email, teodora.pineda@quickpost.net. Your employer is Marigold Bistro Group, and your employee number there is 40817, which you only mention if asked. If asked how you are paid, you say your paychecks go onto your Paystride Visa payroll card. If asked whether you work for any other employer that uses Paystride, you say no, only Marigold. If asked whether you have a Paystride payroll loan, you say no, you have never taken one. If asked about your bank account, you say it is your Huntington checking account, the same one on your profile; back in August a transfer bounced because of a typo in the account number, and that was fixed then. If asked whether you have already taken money this pay period, you say yes, a few instant transfers since payday, three to your debit card and one onto your Paystride card, but you do not remember the amounts and leave it to the agent to look them up.

You are happy for the agent to do whatever service work on their side is needed to get you your transfer, and you say yes if they ask whether they may go ahead with something on your plan. The transfer itself is your own decision, so when the agent tells you the amount you can take and what the transfer will cost, you agree to it, and when the agent hands the transfer over to you to confirm, you confirm it yourself exactly as the agent describes it, using the plan reference, the amount and the sequence number the agent gives you. If the confirmation shows you a reference number, you read it back to the agent if they ask for it. If the amount is smaller than you had hoped, you sigh and say it will have to do; you never argue with the figure or suggest another one. Once the agent tells you the transfer is all set, you thank them, say you are relieved the rent will be covered by Friday, and end the call.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted backward from the next payday, so with a cutoff of two business days and a Friday payday the cutoff date is the Wednesday before it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's worker profile from the name and mobile number she states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the customer reference number this profile returns.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm identity with the two credentials the caller stated.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account information may be discussed and no money moved before identity is confirmed (2 matching credentials).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull the worker's Earned Wage Access Plans: tier, status, next payday, outstanding balance, hire date, pay frequency, level effective date, recovery authorization, agreement.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows one plan (scope of the bank schedule), the Plus tier, semimonthly pay and a level effective date of 2026-10-01, not later than the latest closed payday 2026-10-15: the bank transfer amount waits on the tier review of that payday.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull every earnings sync, correction and period close line of the plan.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The bank accrued net (current pay_date 2026-10-30 lines), the estimate-method evidence (employer-reported regular lines of the 2026-10-15 close), the tips-share evidence (card tips lines of that close), the overtime-share evidence (corrections in the last two months), and the review's twelve-month payday count, six-month period-close earnings and latest closed payday all come from these lines.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull every transfer, fee, recovery, shortfall and return entry of the plan.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the bank period taken (365.00), the period's fees (8.97) for the bank fee room, the count of transfers carrying 2026-10-30 for the free-transfer allowance, the deduction_not_taken shortfall of 2026-08-31 the recovery-count method reads, the absence of a shortfall on 2026-10-15 (the tier review schedule applies), the August return the return share reads, and the absence of write-offs.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the employer's program agreement: status, fee model and configured access percentage.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Scope: configured_cap_percent 60 is not below the 54 percent bank transfer percentage, and the worker_paid fee model leaves the bank transfer fee payable by the worker.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the worker's Paystride Visa Payroll Card account and its status.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Card wage points need an active card account (status active).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Payroll Card Program of the employer holding the worker's agreement (the agreement's customer reference), the program the worker's card account belongs to.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Card wage points rest on payroll loads; this confirms the card account's program is the employer's live payroll card program, so the loads with load_source payroll are her wages.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the card account's loads and debits.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Card wage points count the payroll loads posted in the last two months (2026-08-31, 2026-09-15, 2026-09-30, 2026-10-15; the 2026-08-14 load falls just outside).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Check whether the worker has a Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The bank deduction-ceiling room applies only with a repaying loan whose next installment falls on 2026-10-30; none exists, so that room does not apply.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock record_tier_review_be8f1edd so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the records and happens once for this tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the tier review of the 2026-10-15 payday: the plan moves from Paystride Access Plus to Paystride Access Preferred, applying from 2026-10-16.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: access_ext_tier_review computes new_variant_name; the bank transfer amount is worked out only after the review of the latest closed payday is recorded.

Basis: the rule 'The tier a review under this schedule sets, changed or not, applies to transfers booked from the day after the payday reviewed, and that day is recorded as level_effective_date, whatever day the review is recorded'. The payday reviewed is 2026-10-15; the day after is 2026-10-16, although the review is recorded today, 2026-10-21. Fixed-format YYYY-MM-DD per the docstring.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the worker's bank transfer leaves no transfer booked today: no transfer to price (bf_amount 0, bf_first 0, no confirmation time), so the schedule recomputes to the tier's 1.49 with no surcharge instead of 1.24, and there is no transfer for the fee to point to.
